candidates.source_name: NBS – Subjekty finančného trhu (database of supervised financial market entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Master NBS database enumerating every supervised entity in SK by sector (banks, branches of foreign banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, limited payment service providers, payment agents, crypto-asset service providers, funds, insurers). This is the canonical map of actors from which all actor-level sources are discovered, and it reflects new authorisations and revocations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic (weekly) crawl of sector list pages by segment id (?s=NNN); a JSON/codelist endpoint was referenced in search results (e.g. /api/cl) and a 'Databáza na stiahnutie' bulk download option appears on the site – prefer the bulk download/API over HTML scraping, diff snapshots to detect entrants/exits.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from NBS registre hub
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register
NBS zoznam bánk a pobočiek zahraničných bánk platobné inštitúcie agenti platobných služieb zoznam

candidates.source_name: NBS – Registre (registers hub page)
candidates.why_relevant: Hub page linking every register NBS operates (PSD2 register, financial agents/advisors, creditors, AIFM managers, CERI regulated information, RBUZ credit and guarantee register, professional competence). Best single snowball node for register discovery.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly fetch + link-diff to detect new/retired registers.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of NBS site section
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register podľa PSD2 (PSD2 register of payment service providers and agents)
candidates.why_relevant: National PSD2 register: authorised payment institutions, e-money institutions, AISPs, limited-scope providers and their agents/branches. Core actor list for the payments workstream and the feed that populates the EBA central register for SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly fetch of the register page and any linked export files; cross-check against EBA PSD2 central register download for SK.
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Platobné inštitúcie a AISP (payment institutions and AISPs section)
candidates.why_relevant: Supervisory landing page for PI/AISP licensing: application requirements, forms, notification duties, and links to the entity lists. Useful for spotting licensing-process changes and deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly HTML diff; the sk-language twin under /dohlad-nad-financnym-trhom/ should be tracked in parallel as it usually updates first.
queries_used: NBS zoznam bánk a pobočiek zahraničných bánk platobné inštitúcie agenti platobných služieb zoznam

candidates.source_name: registre.nbs.sk – NBS register portal (professional competence, other registers)
candidates.why_relevant: Dedicated NBS registers portal hosting sub-registers (odborná spôsobilosť for institutions and persons, and others). Search results indicate daily refresh from source databases (~05:00, regenerated hourly), which makes it usable as a change-detection feed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled query of sub-register endpoints; respect the documented daily refresh window.
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register

candidates.source_name: regfap.nbs.sk – Register finančných agentov a finančných poradcov
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register of financial agents and financial advisors (distribution layer for banking/insurance/payment products). Enumerates thousands of intermediary actors and their sectoral scope — key for channel/partner mapping.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginated query scraping with polite rate limits; snapshot monthly and diff for entrants/exits.
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register
local_language_terms_used: register finančných agentov a finančných poradcov

candidates.source_name: regver.nbs.sk – Register veriteľov (register of consumer-credit creditors)
candidates.why_relevant: Register of licensed non-bank consumer-credit providers ('nebankovky'). Enumerates lending competitors outside the bank perimeter and flags licence withdrawals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly full-list extraction and diff.
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Zoznam registrov údajov o spotrebiteľských úveroch (list of consumer-credit data registers)
candidates.why_relevant: Points to the recognised private credit-bureau registers operating in SK (a second tier of data infrastructure actors beyond NBS itself).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch; snowball each listed bureau into its own source record.
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register bankových úverov a záruk (RBUZ)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory credit register run by NBS; the page documents reporting obligations and participants, which indirectly identifies every reporting credit institution and the data-submission deadlines they face.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly page + attachment diff (methodology/reporting templates).
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register informácií (DORA ICT third-party register of information)
candidates.why_relevant: DORA register-of-information submissions: SK financial entities must report ICT third-party providers to NBS annually. Highly relevant to a technology vendor's competitive map and carries hard annual deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly page diff plus capture of taxonomy/template attachments; watch for submission-deadline announcements.
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Centrálna evidencia regulovaných informácií (CERI)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovak OAM: central store of regulated disclosures by issuers (including listed banks). Source of mandatory corporate disclosures tied to statutory deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled query by issuer for banking-sector entities; ingest new filings.
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobné inštitúcie register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Kryptoaktíva: udelenie povolenia / dohľad (MiCA CASP licensing and list)
candidates.why_relevant: MiCA authorisation pipeline and the resulting list of licensed crypto-asset service providers in SK (a small, fast-moving new licence class; NBS reported six licensed CASPs). Direct evidence of new entrants into the SK payments/crypto perimeter.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bi-weekly page diff plus the matching subjekty.nbs.sk crypto segment listing.
queries_used: NBS register poskytovateľov služieb kryptoaktív MiCA zoznam Slovensko povolenia rozhodnutia NBS

candidates.source_name: EBA – Credit Institutions Register (CIR)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-wide authoritative list of authorised credit institutions including SK entities, downloadable in bulk. Enables cross-border comparison and detects SK banks' authorisations/withdrawals in a standardised schema.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly download of the full register export, filter country=SK, diff against previous snapshot.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register Slovakia payment institutions register

candidates.source_name: EBA – Register of payment and electronic money institutions under PSD2 (central register)
candidates.why_relevant: EU central PSD2 register fed by NBS at least daily; contains SK payment institutions, EMIs, AISPs, agents and passporting data, downloadable in full. The single best machine-readable feed for SK payment-actor changes and inbound passporting competitors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly (or daily) bulk download of the central register, filter home/host country SK, diff for entrants, agent additions and revocations.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register Slovakia payment institutions register

candidates.source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – List of supervised entities (SI/LSI)
candidates.why_relevant: SSM list identifying which SK banks are significant institutions supervised directly by the ECB vs less significant under NBS. Determines which supervisor's consultations and deadlines apply to each SK bank.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the periodically re-published PDF/CSV (URL includes a date stamp — resolve the current one from the ECB list page) and extract SK rows.
queries_used: ECB list of supervised entities Slovakia MFI list statistical register download

candidates.source_name: ECB – List of Monetary Financial Institutions (MFI list), Slovakia subset
candidates.why_relevant: Daily-updated, machine-readable list of MFIs including SK credit institutions and money market funds, with stable identifiers. Ideal reference spine for joining SK entity data across sources.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Automated download of the tab-delimited/CSV MFI dataset (also exposed via the ECB Data Portal dataset 'MFI'), filter country SK, diff daily/weekly.
queries_used: ECB list of supervised entities Slovakia MFI list statistical register download

candidates.source_name: Obchodný register SR (Slovak Commercial Register, Ministry of Justice)
candidates.why_relevant: Legal-entity backbone: IČO, legal form, statutory bodies, shareholders, deposited documents for every SK company including banks, PIs, fintechs and their local subsidiaries. Since 2021 it also records beneficial owners (non-public part). Essential for resolving register names to legal entities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the machine-readable RPO API (api.statistics.sk/rpo/v1) which aggregates ORSR data; use orsr/justice web lookup only for deposited documents (listiny) not exposed via API. Beneficial-ownership entries in ORSR are legally non-public — do not attempt to collect them.
queries_used: Obchodný register SR ORSR register partnerov verejného sektora konečný užívateľ výhod RPVS

candidates.source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS) – beneficial ownership register
candidates.why_relevant: The publicly accessible SK beneficial-ownership register (for entities receiving public funds or contracting with the state — which includes banks/payment providers serving public-sector clients). Verified by authorised persons and administered by the Ministry of Justice, registering court is Okresný súd Žilina.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted lookup by IČO for entities on the NBS supervised lists; capture verification documents (verifikačné dokumenty) as PDFs.
queries_used: Obchodný register SR ORSR register partnerov verejného sektora konečný užívateľ výhod RPVS

candidates.source_name: Register právnických osôb (RPO) – Statistical Office REST API
candidates.why_relevant: Reference register consolidating ORSR, trade register and other source registers since Nov 2017, with a public JSON REST API under CC BY 4.0. The cleanest legal route to bulk entity resolution for every SK actor discovered elsewhere.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Call https://api.statistics.sk/rpo/v1/ (docs on Apiary) for entity lookup/enrichment; cache locally and attribute per CC BY 4.0.
queries_used: Register právnických osôb RPO statistics.sk data.gov.sk otvorené dáta obchodný register API

candidates.source_name: Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ) – Open API
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory filing register of financial statements and annual reports for all SK accounting units, with a documented bulk Open API. Turns the register list of supervised actors into a financially quantified actor map (size, growth, exits).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the documented Open API for incremental bulk pulls keyed by IČO for entities on NBS/EBA lists; annual refresh after filing deadlines.
queries_used: register účtovných závierok registeruz.sk API RÚZ dáta výkazy

candidates.source_name: NBS – Zoznam účastníkov platobného systému SIPS / TARGET-SK
candidates.why_relevant: Participant lists for the domestic retail payment system SIPS and for TARGET-SK. Identifies which institutions actually clear and settle in SK — a sharper commercial map than licence lists alone.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch of both participant lists and diff; sk-language equivalents exist under /platobne-systemy/.
queries_used: NBS zoznam bánk a pobočiek zahraničných bánk platobné inštitúcie agenti platobných služieb zoznam

candidates.source_name: NBS – Štatistika: Banky (banking statistics landing)
candidates.why_relevant: Statistical reporting population of SK banks; the reporting-agent lists and aggregates implicitly enumerate the active credit-institution universe and give the supervisory reporting calendar.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to release calendar; download published datasets and reporting-agent lists.
queries_used: NBS zoznam bánk a pobočiek zahraničných bánk platobné inštitúcie agenti platobných služieb zoznam

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register správcov alternatívnych investičných fondov (AIFM register)
candidates.why_relevant: Register of registered/authorised AIF managers in SK — completes the supervised-entity perimeter beyond banking and payments for a sector=both scope.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch and diff.

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Register konečného užívateľa výhod / registers of economic operators
candidates.why_relevant: Public Procurement Office registers of economic operators and their beneficial owners — an alternative ownership-transparency pointer and the bridge between register data and public-sector contracting by banks/payment vendors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Lookup by IČO for supervised entities and their technology suppliers; ÚVO also publishes open datasets/API for procurement records.

candidates.source_name: data.gov.sk / data.slovensko.sk – Slovak open data catalogue (register datasets)
candidates.why_relevant: National open-data catalogue that indexes register datasets (RPO, ORSR extracts, procurement, statistics) with explicit licences — the discovery layer for legally reusable bulk register data.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the catalogue API by keyword (register, banky, financie) monthly; record dataset licences before ingesting.

candidates.source_name: micascan.eu – pan-European MiCA CASP lookup (referenced by NBS)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregator of national MiCA authorisations that NBS itself points investors to for verifying platform legitimacy; useful as a cross-check and for spotting SK-passported CASPs. Aggregator, so treat as secondary to NBS/ESMA registers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Occasional cross-check only; never use as primary evidence — confirm every entry against NBS or the ESMA register.
candidates.discovered_via_method: mentioned in NBS-related coverage found via local-language search

negative_findings.description: Search results referenced a codelist endpoint at https://subjekty.nbs.sk/api/cl and a 'Databáza na stiahnutie' bulk download on subjekty.nbs.sk, but I did not find published API documentation or terms of use for it during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk/API access to the NBS supervised-entity database is plausible but undocumented in what I could reach; treat the endpoint as a hypothesis to be confirmed by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a documented bulk export exists, the whole SK actor map can be maintained deterministically instead of by HTML scraping.

negative_findings.description: Beneficial-ownership entries recorded in the Obchodný register (since 2021) are legally non-public; only RPVS entries are publicly accessible, and RPVS covers only entities dealing with the public sector.
negative_findings.result_summary: There is no fully public, comprehensive UBO register for all SK financial entities.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership mapping of SK banks/PIs will be partial and must be assembled from RPVS + ORSR shareholder data + group disclosures, not from a single register.

negative_findings.description: The ECB list-of-supervised-entities URL captured is a date-stamped PDF (…202408…); the current edition will live at a different date-stamped path.
negative_findings.result_summary: URL recorded as-is; the stable entry point is the ECB Banking Supervision publications listing, which must be resolved at collection time.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hard-coding the date-stamped PDF will silently go stale or 404.

negative_findings.description: I did not locate a dedicated, separately published SK register page listing payment-service AGENTS as a standalone downloadable list (agenti platobných služieb); agents appear to sit inside the PSD2 register / subjekty.nbs.sk segments and the EBA central register.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone SK agents register found; use the EBA PSD2 central register agent records as the practical source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Agent networks are the distribution edge of the SK payments market; missing them would understate market reach.

negative_findings.description: ESMA registers (investment firms, trading venues, MiCA CASP register) and the Slovak trade-licence register (živnostenský register) were identified conceptually but not searched in depth within this cell's budget.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For sector=both, ESMA-side registers complete the supervised-actor perimeter.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical/archival snapshot source for SK registers was identified — registers show current state only, so entrants and revocations are invisible retrospectively.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish own periodic snapshotting of subjekty.nbs.sk and the EBA registers from run start, and check web.archive.org coverage of registre.nbs.sk / subjekty.nbs.sk for backfill.

coverage_gaps.description: Enforcement/sanction decisions (rozhodnutia NBS, sankcie, odňatie povolenia) as a structured list were not located in this pass, though the crypto licensing page shows NBS publishes decision-stage information.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'rozhodnutia NBS o uložení sankcie', 'odňatie povolenia', 'Vestník NBS' and the NBS legislation/vestník section in a follow-up cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Several EU-level registers (EBA, ECB) exist only in English, and their SK entity names may not match the Slovak legal names used in ORSR/NBS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an IČO/LEI-based crosswalk (RPO API + LEI) rather than name matching when joining EU and SK register data.

coverage_gaps.description: Access terms / robots policies for regfap.nbs.sk, regver.nbs.sk and subjekty.nbs.sk were not checked, so scraping legality and rate limits are unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch robots.txt and terms-of-use for each NBS register subdomain before automated collection; prefer any official export.

brief: Slovakia's register landscape for banking and payments is unusually well centralised: NBS operates one master supervised-entity database (subjekty.nbs.sk) plus a set of statutory sub-registers (PSD2, financial agents, creditors, AIFM, CERI, RBUZ, DORA register of information) indexed from a single hub, and the same data is mirrored upward into the EBA credit-institution and PSD2 central registers and the ECB MFI/SSM lists, which are the machine-readable route in. Legal-entity resolution is best done through the Statistical Office RPO REST API (CC BY 4.0) over the Commercial Register, with financial sizing from the RÚZ Open API; ownership transparency is only partial because ORSR beneficial-ownership entries are non-public and RPVS covers only public-sector counterparties. The main open questions are whether the referenced subjekty.nbs.sk bulk download/API is officially documented, and whether payment-service agents are exposed as a standalone SK list or only via the EBA central register. Registers give current state only, so the run should start its own snapshot-and-diff cadence immediately to make new entrants and licence withdrawals observable.
